accepted.title: Morgan Lee moves from seat 14C to 10A on confirmation IR-D204

persona.name: Morgan Lee
persona.goal: You want to change your seat on your upcoming flight to seat 10A. You only want the seat change: do not ask for or accept any rebooking, cancellation or compensation. Once the agent confirms you are in 10A, thank them and end the conversation.
persona.style: traits: impatience=0.2,confusion=0.1,skepticism=0.2,verbosity=0.3; polite and brief, states the request in the first message.

stateAssertions.description: Booking IR-D204 is still confirmed and now holds seat 10A
stateAssertions.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT b.seat_number = '10A' AND b.status = 'confirmed' FROM bookings b WHERE b.confirmation_number = 'IR-D204'), false) AS ok

stateAssertions.description: IR-D204 still holds exactly PA441 and NY802, both confirmed (no cancel / rebook)
stateAssertions.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(s.flight_number || ':' || s.status, ',' ORDER BY s.seq) = 'PA441:confirmed,NY802:confirmed' FROM booking_segments s WHERE s.confirmation_number = 'IR-D204'), false) AS ok

stateAssertions.description: Taylor Lee's booking LL0EZ6 is unchanged (seat 23A, confirmed, FLT-123 confirmed)
stateAssertions.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT b.seat_number = '23A' AND b.status = 'confirmed' AND (SELECT string_agg(s.flight_number || ':' || s.status, ',') FROM booking_segments s WHERE s.confirmation_number = b.confirmation_number) = 'FLT-123:confirmed' FROM bookings b WHERE b.confirmation_number = 'LL0EZ6'), false) AS ok

trajectoryAssertions.description: The seat change goes through update_seat
No flight is cancelled for a seat change
No rebooking for a seat change

requiredOutputs.description: The agent confirms the new seat 10A

accepted.title: Morgan Lee's PA441 is delayed 5h: rebook onto NY950 and open a compensation case

persona.name: Morgan Lee
persona.goal: You are flying Paris -> New York -> Austin. You heard your first flight from Paris is delayed and you are worried you will miss your connection to Austin. Find out the status, get rebooked on the EARLIEST available flight to Austin (accept the morning one, not the afternoon one), and get whatever hotel and meal support you are entitled to for the delay. Do not cancel anything. End the conversation once you have both the new flight and the compensation confirmed.

knowledge.fact: Your first flight is PA441 from Paris to New York, connecting to NY802 to Austin.
You will need a hotel overnight in New York if you miss the connection.

persona.style: traits: impatience=0.6,confusion=0.2,skepticism=0.3,verbosity=0.4; stressed traveller at the airport, asks for status first, then pushes for the rebooking and the hotel.

stateAssertions.description: IR-D204 keeps PA441, NY802 is replaced, and NY950 (the morning flight) is confirmed; nothing else
stateAssertions.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(s.flight_number || ':' || s.status, ',' ORDER BY s.seq) = 'PA441:confirmed,NY802:replaced,NY950:confirmed' FROM booking_segments s WHERE s.confirmation_number = 'IR-D204'), false) AS ok

stateAssertions.description: Booking IR-D204 is still confirmed (not cancelled)
stateAssertions.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT b.status = 'confirmed' FROM bookings b WHERE b.confirmation_number = 'IR-D204'), false) AS ok

stateAssertions.description: Exactly one compensation case exists, for IR-D204, with the hotel, meal and ground vouchers
stateAssertions.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM compensation_cases) = 1 AND COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_array_length(c.vouchers) = 3 FROM compensation_cases c WHERE c.confirmation_number = 'IR-D204'), false) AS ok

stateAssertions.description: Taylor Lee's booking LL0EZ6 is unchanged
stateAssertions.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT b.seat_number = '23A' AND b.status = 'confirmed' AND (SELECT string_agg(s.flight_number || ':' || s.status, ',') FROM booking_segments s WHERE s.confirmation_number = b.confirmation_number) = 'FLT-123:confirmed' FROM bookings b WHERE b.confirmation_number = 'LL0EZ6'), false) AS ok

trajectoryAssertions.description: The replacement flight is booked with book_new_flight
A compensation case is opened with issue_compensation

requiredOutputs.description: The agent tells the customer the replacement flight NY950

accepted.title: Trap: Taylor Lee cancels FLT-123 (LL0EZ6) - cancel_flight() acts on whatever booking is in context

persona.name: Taylor Lee
persona.goal: You want to cancel your flight FLT-123 from San Francisco to Los Angeles today, confirmation LL0EZ6, because your meeting was cancelled. When the agent asks you to confirm the cancellation, say yes. If the agent says it cancelled any other flight or confirmation number than yours, point that out once and ask it to cancel FLT-123 on LL0EZ6 instead. End the conversation (status goal_achieved) once the agent confirms FLT-123 on LL0EZ6 is cancelled; if after that one correction the agent says it cannot cancel FLT-123, say you will call the airline and end the conversation (this is the expected way to give up, not a mistake). Never ask for a human or supervisor.

knowledge.fact: Your flight is FLT-123 from San Francisco (SFO) to Los Angeles (LAX), departing today at 16:10.

persona.style: traits: impatience=0.4,confusion=0.1,skepticism=0.5,verbosity=0.3; businesslike, gives the confirmation number and flight in the first message, checks the details the agent reads back.

stateAssertions.description: Taylor Lee's FLT-123 on LL0EZ6 is cancelled and the booking is cancelled
stateAssertions.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT b.status = 'cancelled' AND (SELECT string_agg(s.flight_number || ':' || s.status, ',') FROM booking_segments s WHERE s.confirmation_number = b.confirmation_number) = 'FLT-123:cancelled' FROM bookings b WHERE b.confirmation_number = 'LL0EZ6'), false) AS ok

stateAssertions.description: The other passenger's booking IR-D204 is untouched: confirmed, seat 14C, PA441 and NY802 confirmed
stateAssertions.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT b.status = 'confirmed' AND b.seat_number = '14C' AND (SELECT string_agg(s.flight_number || ':' || s.status, ',' ORDER BY s.seq) FROM booking_segments s WHERE s.confirmation_number = b.confirmation_number) = 'PA441:confirmed,NY802:confirmed' FROM bookings b WHERE b.confirmation_number = 'IR-D204'), false) AS ok

stateAssertions.description: No compensation case was opened (the on-time flight is not eligible)
stateAssertions.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM compensation_cases) = 0 AS ok

requiredOutputs.description: The agent confirms that FLT-123 was cancelled
